intro.ja:
嬉野流は▲6八銀で始め、角を7九へ引いて5筋から利きを通す。引き角と斜め棒銀の連携を先に覚え、その後に対棒銀の受けと対四間飛車の鳥刺しを学ぶ。相手の戦法で玉の守り方も変える。

新嬉野流は角引きを保留して▲5七銀を急ぐため、通常の居飛車へ転換しやすい。旧型と新型の歩の受け方を混ぜると守備の手数が変わる。奇襲という名前に頼らず、8筋の薄さと5六の歩の守りを確認する。
intro.en:
Ureshino begins with S-6h and develops a withdrawn bishop through 7i, using the fifth file to open its new diagonal. Learn the bishop-and-oblique-silver coordination first, then study defensive play against Climbing Silver and Bird Stab against Fourth-file Rook. The opponent’s formation changes both the attack and the amount of king shelter you should prepare.

New Ureshino delays the bishop withdrawal and prioritizes S-5g, retaining options to enter more conventional Static Rook formations. Mixing its pawn defense with the older setup changes defensive timing. Treat the opening as a set of coordinated plans rather than a surprise that wins automatically: watch the thin eighth-file defense and whether the pawn on 5f has support.

answer.ja: 棒銀への受けと、四間飛車への鳥刺しの攻め。

courses.title: 嬉野流定跡まとめ: 図1-1 初手▲6八銀が嬉野流の駒組み
courses.titleEn: Ureshino study route: Figure 1-1: Ureshino-style formation with ▲6八銀 on move 1
courses.goalFormation:
図1-1 初手▲6八銀が嬉野流の駒組み
嬉野流は、初手▲6八銀から駒組みを進める奇襲戦法の一種で、アマ強豪の嬉野宏明さんが開発し、プロの対局でも採用例があります。奇襲戦法に分類されますが明確な弱点がなく、相手の戦型や先手後手を問わず使えるため非常に優秀な戦法です。指しこなすには独特の感覚が必要で、初心者にはやや難しい戦法です。

root.commentEn:
Figure 1-1: Ureshino-style formation with ▲6八銀 on move 1
Ureshino-ryu is a surprise opening that starts with ▲6八銀 on the first move. It was developed by the strong amateur Hiroaki Ureshino and has also been used in professional games. Although classed as a surprise opening, it has no clear weakness and can be used as Black or White against any opponent's setup, so it is a very good opening. It requires a distinctive feel to play well and is somewhat difficult for beginners.

courses.title: 嬉野流定跡まとめ: 図1-2 新嬉野流
courses.titleEn: Ureshino study route: Figure 1-2: New Ureshino style
courses.goalFormation:
図1-2 新嬉野流
基本の嬉野流は▲7九角と角を引いて使いますが、新嬉野流は角を引くのを保留して駒組みを進めます。他の戦法に切り替えることもできる、新嬉野流の駒組みを学びましょう。嬉野流を指すなら新嬉野流の手順も知っておきたいところです。

root.commentEn:
Figure 1-2: New Ureshino style
In standard Ureshino-ryu the bishop is retreated with ▲7九角, but Shin-Ureshino-ryu postpones retreating the bishop while building the position. It allows a switch to other openings, so let's learn its piece placement. If you play Ureshino-ryu, you should know the Shin-Ureshino-ryu moves too.

courses.title: 嬉野流定跡まとめ: 図2-1 嬉野流vs棒銀
courses.titleEn: Ureshino study route: Figure 2-1: Ureshino style vs Climbing Silver
courses.goalFormation:
図2-1 嬉野流vs棒銀
嬉野流は8筋が薄い陣形になるため、相手は棒銀で攻めてくることが多くなります。ここでは嬉野流で棒銀を受ける手順を見ます。かなり独特な受け方で、知らないと指せない手も出てきます。棒銀を指す相手は多いので、この変化は必修です。

root.commentEn:
Figure 2-1: Ureshino style vs Climbing Silver
Ureshino-ryu leaves the 8th file thin, so opponents often attack with Climbing Silver. Here we look at how to meet Climbing Silver. The defense is quite unusual and includes moves you cannot find without knowing them. Many opponents play Climbing Silver, so this line is a must-know.

courses.title: 嬉野流定跡まとめ: 図3-1 嬉野流vs四間飛車
courses.titleEn: Ureshino study route: Figure 3-1: Ureshino style vs Fourth File Rook
courses.goalFormation:
図3-1 嬉野流vs四間飛車
嬉野流で四間飛車を相手にするときは、鳥刺しという形で攻めるのが一般的です。鳥刺しの狙いと手順をマスターしておきましょう。特に級位者のアマチュアは四間飛車を指す人が多いので、この指し方はしっかり覚えておきたいところです。

root.commentEn:
Figure 3-1: Ureshino style vs Fourth File Rook
Against the Fourth File Ranging Rook, Ureshino-ryu generally attacks with the Torizashi formation. Master its aims and moves. Many amateur kyu-level players use the Fourth File Ranging Rook, so you should learn this well.

branches.note: 学習用の基本手順。左銀を6八へ上げる。
branches.noteEn: Teaching sequence; adapt to different replies. Develop the left silver to 6h.

branches.note: 後手の角道を開ける。
branches.noteEn: Open White’s bishop diagonal.

branches.note: 角を引き、嬉野流の配置にする。
branches.noteEn: Withdraw the bishop to establish Ureshino’s arrangement.

branches.note: 飛車先の歩を伸ばす。
branches.noteEn: Advance White’s rook pawn.

branches.note: 右銀を中央へ進める。
branches.noteEn: Develop the right silver toward the center.

branches.note: 8六の突破を準備する。
branches.noteEn: Prepare a breakthrough on 8f.

branches.note: 金を7八へ上げ、8筋を支える。
branches.noteEn: Develop the gold to 7h to reinforce the eighth file.

branches.note: 8筋の歩を交換する。
branches.noteEn: Exchange the eighth-file pawn.

branches.note: 飛車先の歩を取り返す。
branches.noteEn: Recapture the enemy rook pawn.

branches.note: 飛車で歩を取り、持ち歩を得る。
branches.noteEn: Capture with the rook to obtain a pawn in hand.

branches.note: 低く歩を打ち、飛車の侵入を防ぐ。
branches.noteEn: Drop a low defensive pawn to block the rook’s entry.

branches.note: 飛車を元の位置へ引く。
branches.noteEn: Withdraw the rook to its original rank.

branches.note: 飛車先の歩を伸ばす。
branches.noteEn: Advance Black’s rook pawn.

branches.note: 銀を4二へ上げる。
branches.noteEn: Develop White’s silver to 4b.

branches.note: 2筋の空間を広げる。
branches.noteEn: Claim more space on the second file.

branches.note: 銀を3三へ進め、飛車先を守る。
branches.noteEn: Develop the silver to 3c to defend the rook file.

branches.note: 玉を6九へ寄せる。
branches.noteEn: Move the king toward 6i.

branches.note: 金を3二へ寄せ、右側を守る。
branches.noteEn: Bring the gold to 3b to defend White’s king-side wing.

branches.note: 5筋の歩を伸ばし、銀の進路を作る。
branches.noteEn: Advance the central pawn to provide a route for the silver.

branches.note: 角を引き、銀の前方を空ける。
branches.noteEn: Withdraw the bishop and clear space ahead of the silver.

branches.note: 3筋の歩を伸ばし、攻めの足場を作る。
branches.noteEn: Advance the third-file pawn to create an attacking platform.

branches.note: 中央の歩を伸ばす。
branches.noteEn: Advance White’s central pawn.

branches.note: 銀を5七へ上げ、中央の歩を支える。
branches.noteEn: Develop the silver to 5g to support the central pawn.

branches.note: 左銀を中央へ進める。
branches.noteEn: Develop White’s left silver toward the center.

branches.note: 銀を4六へ進め、斜め棒銀の配置にする。
branches.noteEn: Advance the silver to 4f for an oblique silver attack.
